scope: Partial evidence review of retained V3 price-identity inputs. This ledger does not emit or amend price_identity_transitions, build a production membership union, or mark issue #68 accepted.

evidence_binding.method: Issuer/SEC transition evidence is bound by official URL, filing accession or issuer release identity, and a document-section locator. Those issuer/SEC source bytes were not retained, so their per-source byte hashes are null. Separately retained Nasdaq index notices are listed with their existing source hashes. The sibling SHA-256 file hashes this ledger's exact bytes.
evidence_binding.source_reuse_permission_review: Issuer/SEC evidence is cited for identity facts only; this ledger does not copy provider membership data or alter price provenance.

status_semantics.accepted: Primary evidence supports the same security/share-class continuity and effective date in the retained identity rows. This is an evidence disposition only; no transition has been emitted or integrated.
status_semantics.unresolved: Primary evidence identifies the ticker event, but retained request-contract dates or coverage prevent a valid transition binding.
status_semantics.rejected: A proposed edge is outside the explicit same-security transition contract and is not supported as a transition by the retained identity rows.

contract_audit.same_chain_and_provider_symbol_match: All 14 predecessor-successor pairs have matching chain_id and provider_symbol equal to the corresponding ticker in the retained request contract.
contract_audit.date_boundary_result: 13 pairs are adjacent (predecessor admitted_end is the calendar day before successor admitted_start); FISV/FI is the sole overlap.
contract_audit.full_contract_overlap_result: Among the 607 identities, the only multi-identity active-date collision in the same chain is FISV/FI, overlapping 2023-06-07 through 2025-11-10.
contract_audit.fiserv_ticker_reuse: Primary issuer/SEC evidence establishes FISV through 2023-06-06, FI from 2023-06-07 through 2025-11-10, and FISV again beginning 2025-11-11. A one-row-per-ticker interval cannot encode these three episodes.

retained_price_rows_reviewed.basis: The retained prices.csv in the original checkout's ignored acquisition tree was read-only audited and is bound by prices_csv_sha256 in parent_inputs; it is not copied into Git.
retained_price_rows_reviewed.interpretation: Provider rows for both symbols do not independently define point-in-time issuer-symbol admission or resolve the repeated FISV ticker episode.

sp500.source_basis: Secondary Wikipedia-derived event history with five official S&P DJI spot checks.
sp500.disposition: Retained dated rows exist, but this is not a complete primary-source event ledger or a verified 2025-12-31 state.

nasdaq100.disposition: Specific official notices support bounded event facts; no admissible complete 2021–2025 seed and event timeline is retained.

russell2000.disposition: No Russell 2000 membership rows are retained.

candidates.representation_gap: Do not truncate the existing FISV row or extend FI. The accepted source chronology has three date-bounded symbol episodes but the current identity contract keys one interval by ticker string and cannot distinguish the pre-2023 and post-2025 FISV episodes.
candidates.proposed_safe_disposition: Keep both transition edges out of the integrated transition list and quarantine this chain from accepted continuity joins until a reviewed segment-ID contract and resolver can encode the three episodes.
candidates.validation_gap: The V3 transition reader checks that the successor is admitted on the effective date but does not enforce that predecessor.admitted_end is before that date or that predecessor.admitted_start is before it. The normalizer's authenticated_transition_exit can also bypass predecessor date bounds. Enforce predecessor and successor chronology separately from a future segment-ID schema.

required_fixture_and_reader_review.recommendation: Coordinate a narrowly scoped validation change before integrating any transition list: require predecessor.admitted_start < effective_date, predecessor.admitted_end < effective_date, and successor.admitted_start <= effective_date <= successor.admitted_end; for a continuous ticker rename, require adjacent bounds or an explicit documented gap. Keep the membership-active-prior-session check separate.
required_fixture_and_reader_review.implemented_normalizer_validation: The membership normalizer validates predecessor dates in both _load_price_identity and direct _normalize calls. The shared core/pit_data.py transition contract remains unchanged.
